ALLOWED.category: Permissive licenses compatible with commercial use

developer_only_deps.policy: RESTRICTED licenses may be used in devDependencies (build tools, testing frameworks, etc.) but MUST NOT appear in production/runtime dependencies

dual_licensed.policy: Use or declare the most permissive option available
dual_licensed.example: Some MIT/GPL dual-licensed packages should be marked as MIT

enforcement.ci_gate_critical: FAIL the CI build if any FORBIDDEN license detected in any dependency
enforcement.ci_gate_production: FAIL if any RESTRICTED license detected in production/runtime dependencies
enforcement.ci_gate_dev: WARN if RESTRICTED license detected in devDependencies (FYI, not blocking)
enforcement.ci_gate_new_deps: Scan all newly added dependencies before merge
enforcement.escalation: License compliance issues escalate to security team for review

action: 1. Identify alternative package with ALLOWED license
2. Test with full suite before merge
3. Create issue for major version upgrades requiring API changes

exemptions.note: Exemptions require written justification, security review, and approval from @kushin77
exemptions.process: Submit exemption request in .license-policy-exemptions.json with justification
exemptions.review_frequency: Exemptions reviewed quarterly for removal opportunity
